notes: Reframes Home around one next creation action.

VS-107@1.8 recovers the clean authenticated Brand E2E flow by removing demo fallbacks, executing manual Hunter from Brand Brain, tightening extraction/readiness quality, and aligning source planning with configured runtime capabilities.
